note: The objects on the sea (plan 0005, R13a). tools/geo/build.py puts the ships, the boats, the basket boats (thúng), and the rows of fishing stakes at random points in their areas (with the seed, so the result is always the same) and writes data/geo/build/sea_objects.json. A point on land, or where the sea floor is higher than min_floor_m, is not used. An area of boats can keep away from a beach (away_from_beach). The pier and the groynes come from OSM. Areas are [lon, lat] points. The areas of the cargo ships are builder estimates from photos of the coast: check. The ships are 2 to 6 km from the beaches, because the camera sees 6 km in this world. The fishing boats, the thúng, and the stakes follow plan 0005, Q6 (2026-10-26): the boats are moored all over the bay of Bãi Trước, most dense in the south part in front of the sea wall from the park to Xóm Lưới, a few near the sand at the ends of the beach, and at least 100 m from the sand in front of the swimmers of the main beach. Fishermen go to the boats in thúng. Rows of fishing stakes stand in the sea off Hạ Long. The areas are builder values from the map: check.
